currency.name: tinybar
currency.comment: All `stakeRequirementPolicy.*BaseUnits` fields are Hedera tinybar (1 HBAR = 1e8 tinybar). The legacy `stakeRequirement` / `stakeDefaults` fields remain in wei (1e18) for ABI compatibility with composition/w6-stake-gate.mjs — those are flat legacy minimums, NOT the formula output.

stakeDefaults.comment: Default production minimum: 1 ETH (10^18 wei). Dev override: 0.1 ETH. See composition/w6-stake-gate.mjs. (Legacy wei field — not used by the L-ECONOMICS-FORMULA.)

stakeFormulaReference.notes: L-ECONOMICS-FORMULA (L-ECONOMICS-FIX-TINYBAR): each profile's `stakeRequirementPolicy` is consumed by resolveGateForProfile via buildStakeGateFromPolicy(). All base-unit fields are tinybar (1e8 per HBAR), NOT wei. The formula returns stake > (share*price - inferenceCost) / (auditProb * slashPerStrike * pBeat) * 1.10 (10% safety margin). cumulativeSlashCap() caps total drain across many strikes at stakeBaseUnits * maxTotalSlashRatio (default 1.0 = full drain). See docs/handoffs/w6-v3-economics-formula.md.

profiles.pinReason: The hosted application contract is fixed; the verifier lane has not yet produced its final profile SHA-256/reference-bank pin, so audits fail closed.

stakeRequirementPolicy.notes: DEMO: 1 tinybar inference price with sponsor-covered cost. Gross margin truncates to 0 so the formula returns stake=0n; the flat 0.1 ETH dev minimum still applies via legacy stakeRequirement. Economic deterrence is provided by the sponsor + dev profile, not the stake. auditProbability 0.15 = 0.10 random + 0.05 escalated. cumulativeSlashCap defaults to 1.0 (full drain across many strikes).

profiles.pinReason: The sealed verifier profile is pinned, but the hosted application's 27B profile digest has not yet been supplied by the serving adapter, so quote admission fails closed.

stakeRequirementPolicy.notes: PRODUCTION (L-ECONOMICS-FIX-TINYBAR): price=1e8 tinybar = 1 HBAR per inference, cost=5e7 tinybar = 0.5 HBAR -> gross margin 0.3 HBAR = 3e7 tinybar. Formula yields required stake ~2 HBAR = 2e8 tinybar (REASONABLE — not 6600 ETH). auditProbability 0.15 = 0.10 random + 0.05 escalated; slashPerStrike 0.10; cumulativeSlashCap defaults to 1.0 so dishonest providers can have their ENTIRE stake drained across ~10 strikes. isEconomicallyInfeasible=TRUE under these parameters.
